mapper.select: SELECT ORDERT.ORD_PRN, ORDERT.ORD_CODE, PRODUCT.PROD_CODE, CONVERT(VARCHAR,ORDERT.ORD_DATE,23) AS ORD_DATE, CORP.CORP_NAME, PRODUCT.PROD_NAME, CONVERT(VARCHAR,ORDERT.ORD_NAP,23) AS ORD_NAP, PRODUCT.PROD_NO, PRODUCT.PROD_GYU, PRODUCT.PROD_JAI, PRODUCT.PROD_PG + ' ' + PRODUCT.PROD_PG1 + '~' + PRODUCT.PROD_PG2 AS prod_pg, PRODUCT.PROD_SG + ' ' + PRODUCT.PROD_SG1 + '~' + PRODUCT.PROD_SG2 AS Prod_sg, PRODUCT.PROD_GD4 + '~' + PRODUCT.PROD_GD5 AS Prod_cd, PRODUCT.PROD_E1, TECHIN.TECH_TE, ORDERT.ORD_LOT, ORDERT.ORD_GYU, ROUND((ORDERT.ORD_SU * ORDERT.ORD_DANJ),2) AS ORD_AMNT, ORD_DANG, ORDERT.ORD_MON, ORDERT.ORD_DANW, ROUND(ORDERT.ORD_SU, 1) as ORD_SU, ORDERT.ORD_SUNIP, case when ORD_CHULHACHECK ='true' then '출고' else '미출고' END AS ORD_CHULHACHECK, ORDERT.ORD_DANJ, ORDERT.ORD_BIGO, ORDERT.ORD_NAME, CASE WHEN [ORDERT].[ORD_T02] = '1' THEN 'O' ELSE 'X' END AS ORD_T02, CASE WHEN [ORDERT].[ORD_T01] = '1' THEN 'O' ELSE 'X' END AS ORD_T01, ORDERT.ORD_BOXSU, IPTEST.ITST_WP FROM ORDERT INNER JOIN PRODUCT ON ORDERT.PROD_CODE = PRODUCT.PROD_CODE INNER JOIN CORP ON PRODUCT.CORP_CODE = CORP.CORP_CODE INNER JOIN IPTEST ON ORDERT.ORD_CODE = IPTEST.ORD_CODE LEFT OUTER JOIN TECHIN ON PRODUCT.TECH_NO = TECHIN.TECH_NO WHERE CONVERT(CHAR(19),ORDERT.ORD_DATE,120) BETWEEN CONCAT(#{sdate},' 00:00:00') AND CONCAT(#{edate},' 23:59:59')

SELECT PRODUCT.PROD_CODE, CORP.CORP_NAME, PRODUCT.PROD_NAME, PRODUCT.PROD_NO, PRODUCT.PROD_GYU, PRODUCT.PROD_JAI, TECHIN.TECH_TE, CONCAT(PRODUCT.PROD_PG,' ',PRODUCT.PROD_PG1,'~',PRODUCT.PROD_PG2) AS Prod_PG, CONCAT(PRODUCT.PROD_SG,' ',PRODUCT.PROD_SG1,'~',PRODUCT.PROD_SG2) AS Prod_SG, CONCAT(PRODUCT.PROD_GD4,'~',PRODUCT.PROD_GD5) AS Prod_Cd, PRODUCT.PROD_GUBN, PRODUCT.PROD_E1, PRODUCT.PROD_E3, PRODUCT.PROD_DANW, PRODUCT.PROD_DANJ, PRODUCT.PROD_DANG, PRODUCT.PROD_CNO, PRODUCT.PROD_GD1, PRODUCT.PROD_GD2, PRODUCT.PROD_GD3, PRODUCT.PROD_BOXSU FROM PRODUCT INNER JOIN CORP ON PRODUCT.CORP_CODE = CORP.CORP_CODE LEFT OUTER JOIN TECHIN ON PRODUCT.TECH_NO = TECHIN.TECH_NO

INSERT INTO ORDERT (ORD_CODE, ORD_PRN, ORD_INPUT, PROD_CODE, ORD_DATE, ORD_NAP, ORD_LOT, ORD_DANW, ORD_DANG, ORD_DANJ, ORD_SU, ORD_AMNT, ORD_MON, ORD_NAME, ORD_GYU, ORD_SUNIP,ORD_BOXSU) VALUES( #{ord_code}, 0 , #{ord_date}, #{prod_code}, #{ord_date}, DATEADD(DAY,10,#{ord_date}), '', #{ord_danw}, #{ord_dang}, #{ord_danj}, #{ord_su}, #{ord_amnt}, #{ord_mon}, #{ord_name}, '', '선입1', #{ord_boxsu})

INSERT INTO IPTEST( ITST_CODE, ORD_CODE, ITST_POOR, ITST_DATE, ITST_WP, ITST_WN, ITST_WS, ITST_SU, ITST_05N, ITST_05S, ITST_03N, ITST_03S, ITST_01N, ITST_01S, ITST_051, ITST_052, ITST_053, ITST_054, ITST_055, ITST_031, ITST_032, ITST_033, ITST_034, ITST_035, ITST_011, ITST_012, ITST_013, ITST_014, ITST_015, ITST_P,ITST_06N,ITST_06S,ITST_07N,ITST_07S,ITST_08N,ITST_08S, ITST_04N,ITST_04S,ITST_02N,ITST_02S,ITST_11N, ITST_12N, ITST_121, ITST_122, ITST_123, ITST_124, ITST_111, ITST_112, ITST_113, ITST_114 ) SELECT ISNULL(MAX(ITST_CODE), 0)+1, #{ord_code}, '', #{ord_date}, '검사대기', '외관', '녹없을것', '5EA', '가공칩', '가공칩없을것', '이물질', '이물질없을것', '찍힘', '찍힘없을것', 'OK', 'OK', 'OK', 'OK', 'OK', 'OK', 'OK', 'OK', 'OK', 'OK', 'OK', 'OK', 'OK', 'OK', 'OK', #{ord_name}, #{prod_chisu1n},#{prod_chisu1s},#{prod_chisu2n},#{prod_chisu2s}, #{prod_chisu3n},#{prod_chisu3s}, #{prod_chisu4n},#{prod_chisu4s},#{prod_chisu5n},#{prod_chisu5s}, 'OK', 'OK', 'OK', 'OK', 'OK', 'OK', 'OK', 'OK', 'OK', 'OK' FROM IPTEST
mapper.select:
SELECT LEFT(CONVERT(varchar, ORDERT.ORD_DATE, 120), 10) AS ord_date, ORDERT.ord_code, ord_nap, corp_name, prod_name, prod_no, prod_gyu, ord_lot, tech_te, prod_jai, ord_su, (ord_su * ord_danj) AS ord_jung, ord_amnt, ord_danj, prod_upjong, prod_pg, prod_gd1, prod_gd3, prod_gd2, prod_polish, prod_sg, prod_whadeep, itst_wp, prod_vnyl, prod_plt, prod_pad, prod_danch, prod_bangch, ord_bigo, prod_note, ord_sunip, ord_name, ord_boxsu, prod_sg1, prod_sg2, prod_pg1, prod_pg2, prod_gd4, prod_gd5, PRODUCT.prod_code, prod_e1,prod_e2, 'http://127.0.0.1:8082/tkPrint/asd.png' AS prod_img FROM ORDERT AS ORDERT INNER JOIN PRODUCT AS PRODUCT ON ORDERT.PROD_CODE = PRODUCT.PROD_CODE INNER JOIN CORP AS CORP ON PRODUCT.CORP_CODE = CORP.CORP_CODE INNER JOIN TECHIN AS TECHIN ON PRODUCT.TECH_NO = TECHIN.TECH_NO LEFT OUTER JOIN IPTEST AS IPTEST ON ORDERT.ORD_CODE = IPTEST.ORD_CODE WHERE ORDERT.ord_code = #{ord_code}
UPDATE ORDERT SET ord_prn = ord_prn+1 WHERE ord_code = #{ord_code}

SELECT CONVERT(VARCHAR(20),A.ord_input,23) AS ord_input, A.ord_code, B.jisi_h_regtime, CASE WHEN jisi_lot IS NULL THEN '' ELSE CONCAT('TK', LEFT(jisi_lot,6),'-',SUBSTRING(jisi_Lot,7,2), CASE WHEN RIGHT(jisi_lot,1) = '1' THEN 'A' WHEN RIGHT(jisi_lot,1) = '2' THEN 'B' ELSE RIGHT(jisi_lot,1) END ) END AS jisi_lot_view, jisi_lot, E.fac_name, D.corp_name, C.prod_name, C.prod_no, A.ord_su, ISNULL(B.jisi_h_su,0) AS jisi_h_su FROM tb_workheat B LEFT OUTER JOIN ordert A ON A.ord_code = B.jisi_ord_code LEFT OUTER JOIN PRODUCT C ON A.prod_code = C.prod_code LEFT OUTER JOIN CORP D ON D.CORP_CODE = C.CORP_CODE LEFT OUTER JOIN FACILITY E ON E.FAC_CODE = B.jisi_h_hogi WHERE 1=1 AND B.jisi_h_regtime >= CONCAT(#{jisi_sdate},' 00:00:00') AND B.jisi_h_regtime <= CONCAT(#{jisi_edate},' 23:59:59') ORDER BY A.ord_code, B.jisi_lot

SELECT ORDERT.ORD_PRN, ORDERT.ORD_CODE, PRODUCT.PROD_CODE, ORDERT.ORD_DATE, CORP.CORP_NAME, PRODUCT.PROD_NAME, ORDERT.ORD_NAP, PRODUCT.PROD_NO, PRODUCT.PROD_GYU, PRODUCT.PROD_JAI, PRODUCT.PROD_PG + ' ' + PRODUCT.PROD_PG1 + '~' + PRODUCT.PROD_PG2 AS prod_pg, PRODUCT.PROD_SG + ' ' + PRODUCT.PROD_SG1 + '~' + PRODUCT.PROD_SG2 AS Prod_sg, PRODUCT.PROD_GD4 + '~' + PRODUCT.PROD_GD5 AS Prod_cd, PRODUCT.PROD_GD1 + ' ' + PRODUCT.PROD_GD3 + ' '+ PRODUCT.PROD_GD2 +'기준 '+ PRODUCT.PROD_GD4 + '~' + PRODUCT.PROD_GD5 AS PROD_GD, PRODUCT.PROD_E1, TECHIN.TECH_TE, ORDERT.ORD_LOT, ORDERT.ORD_GYU, ROUND(ORD_AMNT,2) AS ORD_AMNT, ORD_DANG, ORDERT.ORD_MON, ORDERT.ORD_DANW, ROUND(ORDERT.ORD_SU, 1) as ORD_SU, ORDERT.ORD_SUNIP, case when ORD_CHULHACHECK ='true' then '출고' else '미출고' END AS ORD_CHULHACHECK, ORDERT.ORD_DANJ, ORDERT.ORD_BIGO, ORDERT.ORD_NAME, CASE WHEN [ORDERT].[ORD_T02] = '1' THEN 'O' ELSE 'X' END AS ORD_T02, CASE WHEN [ORDERT].[ORD_T01] = '1' THEN 'O' ELSE 'X' END AS ORD_T01, ORDERT.ORD_BOXSU, IPTEST.ITST_WP, STD.WSTD_T32, STD.WSTD_T33, STD.WSTD_T41, STD.WSTD_T42, STD.WSTD_T87, STD.WSTD_T43, STD.WSTD_T44, STD.WSTD_T51, STD.WSTD_T52, STD.WSTD_T53, STD.WSTD_T54, STD.WSTD_T30, jisi_j_save_su, jisi_h_save_su FROM ORDERT INNER JOIN PRODUCT ON ORDERT.PROD_CODE = PRODUCT.PROD_CODE INNER JOIN CORP ON PRODUCT.CORP_CODE = CORP.CORP_CODE INNER JOIN IPTEST ON ORDERT.ORD_CODE = IPTEST.ORD_CODE LEFT OUTER JOIN TECHIN ON PRODUCT.TECH_NO = TECHIN.TECH_NO LEFT OUTER JOIN ( SELECT prod_code, MAX(WSTD_CODE) AS WSTD_CODE, MAX(WSTD_T32) AS WSTD_T32, MAX(WSTD_T33) AS WSTD_T33, MAX(WSTD_T41) AS WSTD_T41, MAX(WSTD_T42) AS WSTD_T42, MAX(WSTD_T87) AS WSTD_T87, MAX(WSTD_T43) AS WSTD_T43, MAX(WSTD_T44) AS WSTD_T44, MAX(WSTD_T51) AS WSTD_T51, MAX(WSTD_T52) AS WSTD_T52, MAX(WSTD_T53) AS WSTD_T53, MAX(WSTD_T54) AS WSTD_T54, MAX(WSTD_T30) AS WSTD_T30 FROM workstd GROUP BY prod_code ) AS STD ON PRODUCT.PROD_CODE = STD.PROD_CODE LEFT OUTER JOIN ( SELECT ord_code AS jisi_save_ord_code, ISNULL(SUM(jisi_j_su),0) AS jisi_j_save_su, ISNULL(SUM(jisi_h_su),0) AS jisi_h_save_su FROM tb_workdanch A LEFT OUTER JOIN tb_workheat B ON A.jisi_j_code = B.jisi_j_code_ref GROUP BY ord_code ) AS SAVE_SU ON ORDERT.ORD_CODE = SAVE_SU.jisi_save_ord_code WHERE CONVERT(CHAR(19),ORDERT.ORD_DATE,120) BETWEEN CONCAT(#{jisi_j_sdate},' 00:00:00') AND CONCAT(#{jisi_j_edate},' 23:59:59')
SELECT * FROM tb_workdanch WHERE 1=1 AND jisi_j_code = #{jisi_j_code}

SELECT A.jisi_lot, E.fac_name, C.ord_code, F.corp_name, D.prod_name, D.prod_no, D.prod_jai, D.PROD_PG + '' + D.PROD_PG1 + ' 이상' AS prod_cd, D.PROD_GD1 + ' ' + D.PROD_GD3 + ' '+ D.PROD_GD2 +'기준 '+ D.PROD_GD4 + '~' + D.PROD_GD5 AS prod_gd, '~' AS aaa, D.prod_e1, A.jisi_h_su, ROUND(A.jisi_h_jung,2) AS jisi_h_jung, A.jisi_h_pre_temp, A.jisi_h_chim_temp, A.jisi_h_diff_temp, A.jisi_h_gang_temp, A.jisi_h_pre_time, A.jisi_h_chim_time, A.jisi_h_diff_time, A.jisi_h_gang_time, A.jisi_h_chim_cp, A.jisi_h_diff_cp, A.jisi_h_gang_cp, A.jisi_h_cold_time, A.jisi_h_cold_temp, A.jisi_t_temp, A.jisi_t_time, A.jisi_h_regtime, G.TECH_TE, H.user_name, CASE WHEN jisi_lot IS NULL THEN '' ELSE CONCAT('TK', LEFT(jisi_lot,6),'-',SUBSTRING(jisi_Lot,7,2), CASE WHEN RIGHT(jisi_lot,1) = '1' THEN 'A' WHEN RIGHT(jisi_lot,1) = '2' THEN 'B' ELSE RIGHT(jisi_lot,1) END ) END AS jisi_lot_view FROM tb_workheat A INNER JOIN ORDERT C ON A.jisi_ord_code = C.ord_code INNER JOIN PRODUCT D ON C.prod_code = D.prod_code INNER JOIN FACILITY E ON A.jisi_h_hogi = E.FAC_CODE INNER JOIN CORP F ON F.corp_code = D.corp_code INNER JOIN TECHIN G ON D.TECH_NO = G.TECH_NO INNER JOIN USERT H ON A.jisi_h_user_code = H.user_code WHERE 1=1 AND A.jisi_lot = #{jisi_lot}

SELECT A.jisi_h_code, A.jisi_h_su, ROUND(A.jisi_h_jung,3) AS jisi_h_jung, A.jisi_lot, B.ord_code, B.ord_name, ISNULL(B.ord_bigo,'') AS ord_bigo, B.ord_lot, B.ord_gyu, B.ord_su, B.ord_amnt, B.ord_mon, C.prod_no, C.prod_name, C.prod_gyu, C.prod_jai, C.prod_danj, C.prod_upjong, C.PROD_PG + ' ' + C.PROD_PG1 + '~' + C.PROD_PG2 AS prod_gd, -- 표면경도 C.PROD_GD1 + ' ' + C.PROD_GD3 + ' '+ C.PROD_GD2 +'기준 '+ C.PROD_GD4 + '~' + C.PROD_GD5 AS prod_pg, -- 경화깊이 C.PROD_SG + ' ' + C.PROD_SG1 + ' ~ ' + C.PROD_SG2 AS prod_sg, -- 심부경도 C.prod_polish, C.prod_Plt, C.prod_pad, C.prod_danch, C.prod_bangch, C.prod_note, C.prod_e1, C.prod_vnyl, CASE WHEN C.prod_fac1 = 1 THEN 'O' ELSE 'X' END AS fac1, CASE WHEN C.prod_fac2 = 1 THEN 'O' ELSE 'X' END AS fac2, CASE WHEN C.prod_fac3 = 1 THEN 'O' ELSE 'X' END AS fac3, CASE WHEN C.prod_fac4 = 1 THEN 'O' ELSE 'X' END AS fac4, CASE WHEN C.prod_fac5 = 1 THEN 'O' ELSE 'X' END AS fac5, CASE WHEN C.prod_fac6 = 1 THEN 'O' ELSE 'X' END AS fac6, CASE WHEN C.prod_fac7 = 1 THEN 'O' ELSE 'X' END AS fac7, D.corp_name, E.tech_te, CEILING(B.ord_mon / B.ord_su) AS cost_ea, CEILING(B.ord_mon / B.ord_amnt) AS cost_kg, F.user_name, 'asd.png' AS prod_img, (CEILING(B.ord_mon / B.ord_su) * jisi_h_su) AS jisi_h_cost FROM tb_workheat A LEFT OUTER JOIN ordert B ON A.jisi_ord_code = B.ord_code LEFT OUTER JOIN product C ON B.prod_code = C.prod_code LEFT OUTER JOIN CORP D ON C.corp_code = D.corp_code LEFT OUTER JOIN TECHIN E ON C.tech_no = E.tech_no LEFT OUTER JOIN USERT F ON A.jisi_h_user_code = F.user_code WHERE jisi_lot = #{jisi_lot}

SELECT * FROM ( SELECT CONVERT(VARCHAR(20),A.ord_input,23) AS ord_input, A.ord_code, D.corp_name, C.prod_name, C.prod_no, C.prod_code, A.ord_su, ISNULL(B.jisi_h_su,0) AS jisi_h_su, (A.ord_su - ISNULL(B.jisi_h_su,0)) AS jisi_diff_su, CASE WHEN wstd_t43 = '' THEN 0 ELSE REPLACE(wstd_t43,',','') END AS jisi_j_su, rnum FROM ordert A LEFT OUTER JOIN ( SELECT ord_code, SUM(ilbo_su) AS jisi_h_su FROM workilbo WHERE ilbo_gubn = 'J' GROUP BY ord_code ) B ON A.ord_code = B.ord_code LEFT OUTER JOIN PRODUCT C ON A.prod_code = C.prod_code LEFT OUTER JOIN CORP D ON D.CORP_CODE = C.CORP_CODE LEFT OUTER JOIN ( SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY prod_code ORDER BY prod_code) AS rnum FROM workstd ) E ON C.PROD_CODE = E.PROD_CODE ) AS AA WHERE 1=1 AND ord_input >= CONCAT(#{sdate},' 00:00:00') AND ord_input <= CONCAT(#{edate},' 23:59:59') AND jisi_diff_su > 0 AND rnum = 1 ORDER BY ord_code

SELECT * FROM ( SELECT CONVERT(VARCHAR(20),A.ord_input,23) AS ord_input, A.ord_code, D.corp_name, C.prod_name, C.prod_no, C.prod_code, A.ord_su, ISNULL(B.jisi_h_su,0) AS jisi_h_su, (A.ord_su - ISNULL(B.jisi_h_su,0)) AS jisi_diff_su, ISNULL(REPLACE(E.wstd_t43,',',''),0) AS jisi_j_su, rnum FROM ordert A LEFT OUTER JOIN ( SELECT ord_code, SUM(ilbo_su) AS jisi_h_su FROM workilbo WHERE ilbo_gubn = 'J' GROUP BY ord_code ) B ON A.ord_code = B.ord_code LEFT OUTER JOIN PRODUCT C ON A.prod_code = C.prod_code LEFT OUTER JOIN CORP D ON D.CORP_CODE = C.CORP_CODE LEFT OUTER JOIN ( SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY prod_code ORDER BY prod_code) AS rnum FROM workstd ) E ON C.PROD_CODE = E.PROD_CODE ) AS AA WHERE 1=1 AND ord_input >= CONCAT(#{sdate},' 00:00:00') AND ord_input <= CONCAT(#{edate},' 23:59:59') AND prod_code = #{prod_code} AND jisi_diff_su > 0 AND ord_code < #{ord_code} AND rnum = 1 ORDER BY ord_code

SELECT * FROM ( SELECT CONVERT(VARCHAR(20),A.ord_input,23) AS ord_input, A.ord_code, D.corp_name, C.prod_name, C.prod_no, C.prod_code, A.ord_amnt, A.ord_su, ISNULL(B.jisi_h_su,0) AS jisi_h_su, C.prod_danj, A.ord_danj, ISNULL(B.jisi_h_su,0) AS jisi_suc_su, (A.ord_su - ISNULL(B.jisi_h_su,0)) AS jisi_diff_su, C.PROD_PG + '' + C.PROD_PG1 + '~' + C.PROD_PG2 AS jisi_h_work_q_hard_std, C.PROD_GD1 + ' ' + C.PROD_GD3 + ' '+ C.PROD_GD2 +'기준 '+ C.PROD_GD4 + '~' + C.PROD_GD5 AS jisi_h_work_q_hard_std2, ISNULL(REPLACE(E.wstd_t43,',',''),0) AS jisi_j_su, rnum, E.wstd_gj11 AS jisi_h_pre_temp, E.wstd_gj12 AS jisi_h_chim_temp, E.wstd_gj13 AS jisi_h_diff_temp, E.wstd_gj14 AS jisi_h_gang_temp, E.wstd_gj15 AS jisi_h_crack_temp, E.wstd_gj16 AS jisi_h_cold_temp, E.wstd_gj21 AS jisi_h_pre_time, E.wstd_gj22 AS jisi_h_chim_time, E.wstd_gj23 AS jisi_h_diff_time, E.wstd_gj24 AS jisi_h_gang_time, E.wstd_gj25 AS jisi_h_crack_time, E.wstd_gj26 AS jisi_h_cold_time, E.wstd_gj31 AS jisi_h_pre_cp, E.wstd_gj32 AS jisi_h_chim_cp, E.wstd_gj33 AS jisi_h_diff_cp, E.wstd_gj34 AS jisi_h_gang_cp, E.wstd_gj35 AS jisi_h_crack_cp, CASE WHEN E.wstd_gj42 IS NOT NULL THEN E.wstd_gj42 WHEN E.wstd_gj43 IS NOT NULL THEN E.wstd_gj43 WHEN E.wstd_gj44 IS NOT NULL THEN E.wstd_gj44 END AS jisi_h_rx, CASE WHEN E.wstd_gj52 IS NOT NULL THEN E.wstd_gj52 WHEN E.wstd_gj53 IS NOT NULL THEN E.wstd_gj53 WHEN E.wstd_gj54 IS NOT NULL THEN E.wstd_gj54 END AS jisi_h_lpg, E.wstd_gj17 AS jisi_h_agi, E.wstd_ready AS jisi_t_temp, E.wstd_worktime AS jisi_t_time, E.WSTD_T32, E.WSTD_T33, E.WSTD_T41, E.WSTD_T42, E.WSTD_T87, E.WSTD_T43, E.WSTD_T44, E.WSTD_T51, E.WSTD_T52, E.WSTD_T53, E.WSTD_T54, E.WSTD_T30, 0 AS jisi_default_su FROM ordert A LEFT OUTER JOIN ( SELECT ord_code, SUM(ilbo_su) AS jisi_h_su FROM workilbo WHERE ilbo_gubn = 'J' GROUP BY ord_code ) B ON A.ord_code = B.ord_code LEFT OUTER JOIN PRODUCT C ON A.prod_code = C.prod_code LEFT OUTER JOIN CORP D ON D.CORP_CODE = C.CORP_CODE LEFT OUTER JOIN ( SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY prod_code ORDER BY prod_code) AS rnum FROM workstd ) E ON C.PROD_CODE = E.PROD_CODE ) AS AA WHERE 1=1 AND ord_input >= CONCAT(#{sdate},' 00:00:00') AND ord_input <= CONCAT(#{edate},' 23:59:59') AND prod_code = #{prod_code} AND jisi_diff_su > 0 AND ord_code >= #{ord_code} AND rnum = 1 ORDER BY ord_code

SELECT A.ord_code, CONVERT(VARCHAR(20),A.ord_input,23) AS ord_input, B.prod_code, ISNULL(REPLACE(C.wstd_t43,',',''),0) AS jisi_j_su FROM ordert A LEFT OUTER JOIN PRODUCT B ON A.prod_code = B.prod_code LEFT OUTER JOIN ( SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY prod_code ORDER BY prod_code) AS rnum FROM workstd ) C ON B.PROD_CODE = C.PROD_CODE WHERE 1=1 AND ord_code = #{jisi_h_ord_code} AND rnum = 1
